name: MTOUCHE
recent: mTouche 于 2026 年 9 月 23 日举行第 21 届年度股东大会，除撤回重新选举 Mr Chen Huei Ping 为董事的普通决议案 2 外，其余决议均获通过。公司于 9 月 30 日宣布更改财政年度结束日，并在 9 月 18 日出现 Morgan Stanley 的股权变动申报，包括不再是大股东的通知。
notable: 第 21 届年度股东大会于 2026 年 9 月 23 日举行，除撤回普通决议案 2 外，其余决议均获通过。
公司更改财政年度结束日。
Morgan Stanley 于 2026 年 9 月 18 日申报不再是大股东，并有多项股权变动申报。
risks: Mr Chen Huei Ping 的董事连任决议案在股东大会上被撤回。
Morgan Stanley 申报不再是大股东。

recent_en: mTouche held its 21st AGM on 23 September 2026, where all resolutions were passed except Ordinary Resolution 2 for the re-election of Mr Chen Huei Ping as director, which was withdrawn. The company announced a change in financial year end on 30 September, and Morgan Stanley filed shareholding changes on 18 September, including a notice of ceasing to be a substantial shareholder.
notable_en: The 21st AGM was held on 23 September 2026, with all resolutions passed except Ordinary Resolution 2, which was withdrawn.
The company changed its financial year end.
Morgan Stanley filed a notice of ceasing to be a substantial shareholder on 18 September 2026, along with several shareholding change notices.
risks_en: The resolution for the re-election of Mr Chen Huei Ping as director was withdrawn at the AGM.
Morgan Stanley filed a notice of ceasing to be a substantial shareholder.
